profile.headline: Software Engineer | JavaScript | React | Node | MongoDB | Express
profile.summary:
I’m Celia Kelly, a detail-oriented full-stack engineer who loves building software to find creative solutions for challenging problems. 
Technical Skills: MERN stack, Javascript, HTML, CSS, MongoDB, Express, React, Node

Before becoming a web developer, I taught middle school Latin for 11 years. I continually explored new online tools to engage my students, organize data, and automate tasks. I also trained colleagues on learning management software and created user-friendly documentation. 

When the pandemic hit, I dove deep into coding, with the goal of building better applications to support teachers and learners. I bring to web development my ability to problem-solve, collaborate with a team, and explain technical topics clearly to non-technical audiences.   

Do you have a software engineering project in mind? I’d love to discuss it with you. Check out my portfolio site (https://www.celiackelly.com/) and Github (https://github.com/celiackelly), and please feel free to reach out.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Collaborated with a team of developers to build responsive web applications using best practices. 
- Built semantically structured full-stack web applications. 
- Applied Agile methodologies for project management and used code review and pair programming to ensure code quality.
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · JavaScript · Express.js · Node.js · React.js

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Built static websites for clients, including two nonprofits with local and regional reach. 
- Communicated with clients to understand their needs, update them on the project's progress, and incorporate their feedback. 
- Trained clients on the use of their content management system and created thorough documentation to support the longterm maintenance of the site.
positions.insights: Skills: CSS · JavaScript · Figma · Webflow · WordPress · HTML

positions.title: Administrative Assistant and Latin Teacher
positions.description:
- Built tools for spreadsheet and email automation using Google Apps Script, to significantly reduce administrative labor.
- Trained school community to use new software and created user-friendly documentation.
positions.insights: Skills: Collaboration · Troubleshooting · Communication · Google Apps Script
